race.title: Celebrate Your Special Occasion At Dundalk Stadium Handicap
race.verdict: GO OUT opened his account at Dundalk 12 days ago and, with first-time blinkers now applied, he is taken to follow up. The lightly-raced Teffian Warrior is the main threat if building on his handicap debut, while reliable sort Boston Max is also likely to be involved. GO OUT (FR) TEFFIAN WARRIOR (IRE) BOSTON MAX (IRE)
